assertions.name: e⁻ (trefoil) universally produces e⁻ channel
assertions.source: e⁻ · b_i · b_j always has e⁻ ≠ 0 for all i,j

assertions.name: γ (identity) does NOT universally produce e⁻
assertions.source: Only 19/36 basis products have e⁻ ≠ 0 under identity

description: Complete multiplication tables for all 6 basis knots of H₃(q). Each table is a 6×6 matrix of 6-element NF vectors showing b_i · K · b_j for basis knot K. The e⁻ channel count progression 19 → 24 → 24 → 32 → 32 → 36 demonstrates that the trefoil is the unique minimum-crossing universal pair-production operator.
